metadata.genre: educational podcast short — numbered top-3 teaching cut
metadata.rationale: 45s vertical teaching cut built as hook → #1 → #2 → #3, one point every ~12-15s (point 1 at 2.0s, point 2 at 15.0s, point 3 at 30.0s). 23 jump-cut shots pull only the sharpest explanatory lines out of the 416.4s source and keep the speaker's wording verbatim — every cut removes filler, a pause or a tangent, never a word. Rhythm evolves by thirds: phase 1 (0-15s) 6 shots / avg 2.50s and cleanest; phase 2 (15-30s) 8 shots / avg 1.88s (75% of phase 1); phase 3 (30-45s) 9 shots / body avg 1.22s (49% of phase 1) then a 5.25s uncut landing hold, the longest shot in the edit. Cut points are quantised to the music bed's grid and land on speech boundaries, never mid-sentence. One coherent grade (colorGrade 1.08/1.05/1.00) across all 23 shots; accents are face-safe (vignette, tonal, grain only — no glitch, no aberration, no blur on the speaker). transitions[] is intentionally EMPTY: the request explicitly asks for hard cuts only with no transitions, so the request wins over the contract minimum. Audio: 'a lot' bed at 0.22 for 0-30.0s only, then hard music-out on the final point (30.0-45.0s is voice + room tone), with 4 one-shot impacts sampled from the track on the hook, the title reveal and the two chapter changes.
